rules.intensity: choose Black Brown for softer result; Soft Black for stronger definition

guardrails: Do not recommend a brow shade substantially darker than the user’s hair unless dramatic intensity is explicitly requested.
When between two shades, prefer the softer/lighter option for a natural result.
Clear Willow Brow Gel is color-neutral and should be recommended when hold/shape is desired without tint.

blue.reason: Warm orange-adjacent tones create complementary contrast; neutrals remain valid.

green.reason: Purple/red-adjacent tones create contrast; warm metallics can add emphasis.

hazel.reason: Both green and brown components can be emphasized using plum/green or warm metallic families.

brown.reason: Brown eyes are visually versatile; saturated jewel tones and metallics can create contrast.

grey.reason: Cool neutrals and muted cool colors support tonal harmony; select warm metallics can create contrast.

outfit_harmony.mode_note: Outfit matching is optional aesthetic coordination, never a hard suitability rule.

neutral_outfits.strategy: Most eye colours work; choose intensity by occasion.

warm_earth.strategy: Use tonal earth harmony or green contrast accents.

blue_navy_teal.strategy: Bronze/copper/gold create warm contrast; navy/charcoal create tonal looks.

green_emerald.strategy: Warm metallics and plum/burgundy contrast greens; olive can create a tonal look.

pink_rose_red.strategy: Use balanced neutrals for soft looks or rose/plum families for coordinated looks.

purple_plum.strategy: Choose neutral framing with one coordinated purple-family accent.

gold_champagne.strategy: Use warm metallics with dark brown/espresso depth; burgundy adds contrast.

bridal.note: Dawnbranch is the catalogue’s explicitly named bridal gold & bronze story.

palette_coordination_rules.rule: Start with a base/transition pan, add crease depth, then optionally add lid shimmer/topper and liner/depth.
Use no more than one vivid/accent family as the dominant eye color for natural or soft-glam recommendations unless the user requests bold/editorial.
For daytime, rank light/medium brightness and muted/medium saturation above deep/vivid options; for evening, allow deeper and more saturated accents.
If outfit harmony conflicts with eye-colour harmony, prefer eye-colour/undertone fit for a flattering result, then use outfit color as a secondary tie-breaker.
Complexion depth adjusts recommended intensity and contrast but must not remove shade families from eligibility.

mascara: Default natural recommendations toward brown/black-brown for softer definition and black shades for stronger definition.
Rank colored mascara only when the user asks for color, bold/editorial styling, or the color meaningfully supports eye/outfit harmony.
brows: Use brow_matching as the primary system; hair depth and temperature dominate.
Do not use outfit color as a primary brow-shade signal.
eyeliner: Black/brown/charcoal are broad neutral defaults; colored liners are boosted by eye-colour and outfit harmony.
Do not infer wear-time, waterproofness, transfer resistance, ophthalmological testing, or formula safety from the product name.
eyeshadow: Use eye-colour harmony, undertone, look style, and outfit as ranking signals.
Use palette pan roles to construct complete looks without treating pans as separate sellable SKUs.

safety_and_claim_guardrails: Only recommend products intended for the eye area.
Never convert an aesthetic recommendation into a safety, hypoallergenic, ophthalmological, wear-time, waterproof, transfer-proof, regulatory, or ingredient claim without verified source data.
If the user reports irritation or an eye infection, do not continue with routine cosmetic use guidance; advise stopping use and following appropriate safety guidance.
Treat 'Kohl Black' strictly as a shade name unless formulation data proves otherwise.
